name: auto-refresh
description: Chrome extension that auto-reloads tabs on a schedule, with hard refresh, random intervals, scroll memory and free page-change alerts.
author: Andrew Karanja

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm test && npm run pack

devDependencies: Optional. Nothing here is needed to develop or ship the extension --
src/ is loaded unpacked directly, and both scripts/ tools use only
node's standard library. These exist solely so `npm run typecheck`
can check the JSDoc types, which is where the ReferenceErrors that
left v1.0.2 non-functional would have shown up as editor squiggles.
